intro: I’m a Support Engineer (NetOps), helping keep network services and infrastructure reliable at a nationwide ISP. I work across networking and infrastructure, with a focus on practical, dependable systems.

Alongside engineering, I work as a research assistant in computational biology, exploring how bioinformatics and systems biology can reveal disease mechanisms, connected pathways, and potential therapeutic targets.
closing: This site brings together my engineering work, research, and what I’m learning along the way.
